notes: Test data only. The passcode is public on purpose.
Paths are relative to the backed-up root "src" with / separators; the Backup Base app restores a root to <folder>\src\<path>.
mtime_ms is Unix time in milliseconds (UTC), the value the vault stores as m. mtime is the same instant in ISO 8601.
attr uses the vault format bits: 1 readonly, 2 hidden (Windows). attributes lists the same by name.
Folders are listed (kind dir), the root itself is not. Empty folders are part of the data.
The device name is a random stand-in: the apps that made these vaults were built with device_name() patched (see README.md).
